file_insights.changes_summary: Added Voice Feedback settings card with toggle, volume, and speech rate controls

patterns_discovered: Separation of concerns: Breaking large functions into smaller, focused composable functions
State management using collectAsState() for reactive UI updates
Card-based UI layout for different settings sections
Conditional rendering based on nullable state
gotchas_discovered: Managing nullable states with fallback using remember { mutableStateOf(null) }
Ensuring UI components are disabled when parent toggle is off

key_implementation_details: Created separate composable for Voice Feedback card

recommendations: Consider extracting reusable components like SettingsToggle and SettingsSlider
Add error handling for potential null states
Implement unit tests for accessibility settings updates
Consider internationalizing slider labels and value formatters
